text:
morgan: FYI — q6b-int4 bringup revealed a nasty edge: our corpus merge step duplicated lots of paraphrases after tokenizer v2 landed. short-term: need a conservative stitch + golden sanity check. anyone free for a quick patch?

sasha: on it. initial diffs point to token boundary shifts (~1-3 tokens) not quant noise. :thinking_face: will validate.

lina: labeling ops seeing lots of resamples in the queue with tiny edits. backlog doubled this hour. i've paused new slices to avoid wasted labels.

jai: my hypothesis: tokenizer v2 + whitespace normalization changed our fingerprint hashes. propose re-fingerprint with tokenizer v2 + fuzzy grouping (minhash) before any golden promotions. run a 2k canary.

ashley: happy to triage relabel backlog. what's the plan for stitch thresholds? i don't want to collapse legit near-duplicates.

morgan: good point. conservative approach: 1) re-fingerprint using token_window (tokenizer v2) 2) cluster with minhash threshold 0.85 3) manual review for top clusters (first 50) 4) only update golden after relabel verification.

sasha: kicking off dedupe job:
```
python -m curation.dedupe \
  --tokenizer v2 \
  --fingerprint algo=token_window,size=64 \
  --minhash_thresh 0.85 \
  --input s3://redwood-curation/incoming/q6b_onboard/2026-03-22/*.ndjson \
  --output s3://redwood-curation/tmp/dedupe-run-4590/
```
will post a short summary in ~12m.

deploy-bot: canary-model q6b-int4-v1 deployed to staging in us-west-2 :rocket: (canary id: canary-4590)

lina: freezing ingestion & setting labeler-queue read-only for 30m. tagging labelers: @ashley please hold bulk assignments.

ashley: 👍 starting relabels from the RQ backlog; prioritizing clusters that touch golden candidates.

jai: i'll spin up a lightweight eval harness: run the canary 2k sample through baseline q8b and q6b-int4-v1; compare tokenized fingerprints and output divergence. flag items where outputs differ >0.15 embedding distance or large token truncation.

morgan: also add a KV-cache prefix check — saw truncated completions in smoke.

sasha: dedupe finished. summary: from 21,422 inputs, 3,112 clusters (size>=2) at 0.85; 412 clusters include a golden candidate. cluster_summary -> s3://redwood-curation/tmp/dedupe-run-4590/cluster_summary.csv

morgan: uploaded first50 sample list for manual review -> s3://redwood-curation/tmp/dedupe-run-4590/first50.csv

lina: doing an audit on first50. i'll mark ambiguous items as "hold" and escalate. :eyes:

ashley: note from labelers: many paraphrases actually change intent. we'll mark those as non-duplicates. conservative stitch seems right.

jai: eval harness running now. rule: if >5% regression on golden subset, we cut rollout and file a regression ticket.

morgan: action items:
- sasha: run full dedupe sweep and produce cluster manifest (done for canary sample)
- lina: freeze ingestion & triage first50 (in progress)
- ashley: handle relabel backlog + review clusters with golden candidates
- jai: run model divergence harness on canary vs baseline (in progress)
- morgan: create regression ticket if divergence >5% on golden

morgan: reconvene in ~30m or earlier if hard regress found. good rapid response, thanks all :thumbsup:
